text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Are you ready, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl suddenly bursts into my office, scaring me a little.
choice_data_list: Ready? For what? We don't have any races coming up…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Non! I'm not talking about races, silly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Remember the promise we made to polish ourselves up so the whole world can see our shine?
choice_data_list: Oh, right! You're talking about the hot spring trip, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remember all the research I had to do into the quality of the spring's water and the inn's food, as per Seeking the Pearl's request.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Exactly that! This is part of my preparations for running in a European G1! I need to make sure I don't bring shame to the Pearl family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's echoing laughter accompanies us all the way to the inn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Phew! Now my skin's all soft and smooth! You're not looking too shabby either, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. It looks like all your exhaustion's been washed away. I knew this was the best time for us to come together.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Both you and I had to overcome many obstacles to make it to this point.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But we both kept believing in our dreams. We believed with our whole heart and body that they would come true.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Maintaining faith in something for that long isn't a simple task.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No matter what sweet words you use to describe it, dreams always come with bitterness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Seeking the Pearl stares at the moonlit sky, I can see all of the races she's run and the hardships she's faced reflected in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But not even a hint of anguish clouds her gaze. Her eyes only sparkle with clear joy.
choice_data_list: Despite that, you still managed to overcome it all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I did… But our dreams and futures don't end here… There's so much more to do.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No matter how long it takes or how many obstacles stand in our way, I know it'll be no problem if we're in it together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: After all, we believe in each other, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We would never betray each other's trust… right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! That's the answer I wanted to hear! That utter lack of hesitation is exactly why you're my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There's nothing for us to be afraid of! Our shining light will surely save the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now all that's left is…

text_block_list.name: Inn Worker
text_block_list.text: Good evening. Your dinner is ready. Would you like me to bring it in now?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, perfect timing! You already looked into the courses for tonight, right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I sure did! I even looked up where each ingredient came from!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All riiight! Good job!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's savor each bite so the flavors, nutrients, and feelings of the chef who prepared our meal can nourish our bodies and become our light!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, then! Please bring in our wonderful dinner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Seeking the Pearl and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
